pub trait Messages
  type Error
  fn observe_delivery(&self, reference: MessageRef, pairing_epoch: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<ObserveDeliveryResult, Self::Error>
  fn inboxes_for_person(&self, cursor: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<InboxPage, Self::Error>
  fn inbox_open_chat(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, source_context: ::std::string::String, status: ::std::string::String, binding: ChatBinding) -> ::std::result::Result<ChatInboxChange, Self::Error>
  fn send_chat(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, source_context: ::std::string::String, request: ChatSendRequest) -> ::std::result::Result<SendResult, Self::Error>
  fn prepare(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, source_context: ::std::string::String, request: PrepareRequest) -> ::std::result::Result<PrepareResult, Self::Error>
  fn reply(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, source_context: ::std::string::String, message_id: ::std::string::String, body: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<SendResult, Self::Error>
  fn inbox_open(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, context: ::std::string::String, status: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<InboxChange, Self::Error>
  fn inboxes_list(&self, query: InboxQuery) -> ::std::result::Result<InboxPage, Self::Error>
  fn send(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, source_context: ::std::string::String, request: SendRequest) -> ::std::result::Result<SendResult, Self::Error>
  fn wait(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, context: ::std::string::String, view: View, after: ::std::string::String, revision: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<Page, Self::Error>
  fn read_for_person(&self, message_id: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<Page, Self::Error>
  fn stop_for_person(&self, message_id: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<StopResult, Self::Error>
  fn turn_wake(&self, instance: ::std::string::String, source_context: ::std::string::String, wake: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<TurnWakeResult, Self::Error>
